description: Paid summer-student roles with the Municipality of Clarington, hired through the federal Canada Summer Jobs program. Work runs April 26 to August 27, 2027, 40 hours a week including evenings, weekends and holidays.
notes: Applications close Sunday, November 22, 2026 at 11:59pm — apply now. Details (wage, deadline, ages, dates) read from the Municipality's Indeed posting text; the posting page itself was not opened directly, so confirm at clarington.net/careers before applying. title: Canada Summer Jobs — summer-student roles

description: Try out a real job for a semester and earn high-school credits for it — morning, afternoon or full school day, usually one semester (5 months). Talk to the school Guidance Counsellor to fit it into the timetable.
notes: Co-op students earn credits, not pay (some employers may offer a small honorarium, but that is not common). About 110 hours per co-op credit (Ontario.ca). Students are covered by WSIB through a Work Education Agreement.
provider: Kawartha Pine Ridge District School Board (KPR)
title: School co-op (co-operative education)

description: Start training in a skilled trade while still in high school: a co-op placement in a trade makes you an OYAP student, registered as an apprentice, earning hours toward the trade. KPR also runs an accelerated stream where you earn Level One trade certification in your final semester of Grade 12.
notes: Apply through the school's co-op department or Guidance Counsellor; KPR's OYAP recruiter is Jennifer Bingham (705-742-9773 x2187). Accelerated Level One applications open in the second semester of Grade 11.
pay: Unpaid co-op — earns credits + apprenticeship hours
provider: Kawartha Pine Ridge District School Board (KPR)
title: Ontario Youth Apprenticeship Program (OYAP)

description: Co-op terms at the Bowmanville cement plant for university engineering students — chemical, mechanical and electrical streams all live on VCNA's careers page right now. Plan-ahead for Owen: this needs an undergraduate engineering program, but it is the best-paid local co-op to aim at.
notes: All three roles live on VCNA's careers page (opened Nov 17, 2026). Each posting lists $25/hr and requires enrolment in an undergraduate engineering program; minimum 12 weeks at 35+ hours a week. The Bowmanville plant is not easily reached by public transit — a student needs their own transport.
title: Engineering co-op student (Chemical / Mechanical / Electrical)

description: Summer co-op terms across OPG's Durham sites (Darlington, Oshawa, Pickering) — business, science, engineering, computer science, communications and skilled trades streams. Plan-ahead for Owen: this needs at least 1st year of university or college completed.
notes: Summer 2026 postings closed January 26–30, 2026 — nothing open right now. Pay bands from the Summer 2026 postings: $32.17–$40.37/hr for most programs, $32.78–$43.68/hr for engineering and communications. Watch jobs.opg.com for the Summer 2027 round.
title: Summer co-op student (Darlington / Durham)

description: Four-month college co-op in Bowmanville for Electrical or Civil Engineering Technology students — hands-on distribution engineering work, reporting to the Bowmanville area office. Plan-ahead for Owen: post-secondary only, and a G2 driver's licence is required.
notes: Summer 2026 posting is closed and the Winter 2027 round's deadline was October 12, 2026 — nothing open right now. Pay and requirements from the Summer 2026 posting (deadline was January 26, 2026). Watch jobs.hydroone.com for the Summer 2027 round.
